title: Use Milou.ResultsDelegate for search results
line: Kickoff's search results now look and work like KRunner's and Overview's, grouped by category with the result's actions on the right.
explanation: Kickoff searched through its own Kicker.RunnerModel and drew the results with its own list view and delegates, so the same results looked different from KRunner and Overview (merged list with descriptions, no category column, no runner action buttons). The change is Niccolò's draft MR !3251 (plus Nate's ScrollView commit on it) ported to current master: the search page is a Milou.ResultsView inside a ScrollView, Kickoff's RunnerModel and the search-only code in its delegates and list view are removed, and the popup closes when a result is run.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: Use Milou.ResultsView for search results

Kickoff showed search results with its own list view and delegates, so
they looked and behaved differently from the same results in KRunner
and Overview. Show them with Milou's shared ResultsView instead.

BUG: 478188

media.caption: Master: searching "settings" in Kickoff shows its own list style (one merged list, descriptions under every name)
With the change: the same search uses Milou's results view, like KRunner and Overview (category column, description on the current result)
